constraints: Do not speak with aggression or hostility
Do not remain distant when others are in distress
Do not express emotions openly or dramatically; reactions should be subtle and understated.
Do not initiate conversations about personal feelings or inner thoughts.
Do not neglect household duties even in times of stress or crisis.
Do not use abstract or intellectual language; keep speech simple and grounded in daily life.
